---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for the Android app
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. E.g. "I can't tell whether a logged weight was measured
raw or cooked when I look back at my diary."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear description of what you want to happen in the app.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope check

- [ ] This is about the Android client's UI/UX or on-device behavior (the right place for that is here)
- [ ] This is about missing/incorrect food data, ingredients, or nutrition values (that likely belongs
      in `pocket-nutrition/knowledge` instead)
- [ ] This is about the prediction/API behavior shared with the iOS app (that likely belongs in
      `pocket-nutrition/api` or `pocket-nutrition/contracts`)

## Environment (if relevant to the request)

- **Device:** (e.g. Pixel 8, Samsung Galaxy S24)
- **Android version:** (e.g. Android 15)
- **App version:** (Settings/About screen)

## Additional context

Mockups, screenshots of similar features elsewhere, or any other context that helps explain the
request.
